description: One building block by type + slug; include=["content"] returns the full body.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline the full body (Pro). Omitted, you get the summary.

slug.description: Building-block slug within `type`, as find_building_blocks returns it, e.g. "access" with type "guidance".

type.description: Building-block type: guidance, rules, policies, standards, strategies, schema, properties, experiences or lifecycle.

name: get_building_block
